name: Art mac Cuinn

attributes.attribute: an Irish hero, son of Conn

sources: Cross, Tom Peete, and Clark Harris Slover, eds. Ancient Irish Tales. (New York: Henry Holt and Co., 1936), 491.

text: Art mac Cuinn is an Irish hero. The name Art means bear. His father, Conn of the Hundred Battles, ruled at Tara. A woman named Bé Chuma lusted after Art and sent him into exile. On his return she ordered him to win Delbchém, a woman of the Otherworld. He won her and brought her back to Tara. He is remembered as the father of the hero Cormac mac Airt. Achtan bore Cormac before Art died at the battle of Mag Mucrama.

okr.objective: Record Art mac Cuinn, the Irish hero and father of Cormac.
